messages.content: joey just chased a squirrel across the yard at full sprint. didn't catch it obviously
Squirrels exist so dogs have a goal. The chase is the point; catching it would break the loop.
took joey to the dog park today. he mostly just sat near me instead of running with the other dogs
He's there for the people-watching, not the play. Some dogs are crowd-from-the-bench types. Nothing wrong with it as long as he's getting walks the rest of the week.
joey's getting older. went up the stairs slow this morning, paused twice

Senior-dog signal — hip or joint, usually. Worth bringing up at the next vet visit if it keeps showing up, not a now-emergency. Carpet runner on the stairs helps if they're hardwood; gives him traction so he's not bracing as hard.
joey laid down right on top of the laundry pile I just folded
Warm, clean, smells like you. He picked the obvious spot. The laundry was always going to lose.
